During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a unit of [[Voss commandos]] under the command of [[Tala-Reh]] '''attacked''' the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] in order to serve as a distraction for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who was [[Mission to the King's Hall|infiltrating]] the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gorma-Koss]].
